changes.location: Triangle reference in Question

changes.location: Final word of the sont ils line

changes.location: Isolated point above the gap after ils; reviewed possible punctuation

changes.location: Ending of the word after par les
changes.evidence: After the clear t, the ending contains a low e/n run and then a separate open c-like bowl, low e hump and downward terminal s hook. No second t ascender appears. This resolves the noun ending; its accent is recorded separately in r1-32.

changes.location: Accent on the vowel after p in compétences

notes: The author introduces a ring on X and sheaves M,N as K^0 and K^1 associated with the additive champ of projective A-Modules. The first letter of the abbreviated qualification before f. remains unresolved. These are reported as the author’s statements, not independently verified mathematics.

The author attributes a construction (the word remains partly uncertain) to Mme Sinh and says it gives an épinglé Picard champ and a canonical section of a middle term. The written verb reads fourni, and the copied formula ends at N without a visible closing parenthesis. Neither grammar nor expected notation was used to repair those forms.
NB asserts evident functorialities in M,N,X. The compact ending of fonctorialités remains uncertain in the transcription.

Under the explicit lead Question, the author asks whether the exact triangle and exact sequence are known by the named compétences, listing Quillen, Breen and Illusie, and asks about higher variants. The final parenthesis proposes a géométrique principle that pourrait pass through n-champs de Picard non néc. stricts. These question marks and the word pourrait are the author’s expressions of inquiry or tentativeness, distinct from transcription doubts.

Mathematical notation prompted targeted ink inspection of each ring A, the separately raised degrees 0 and 1, P/F and its edge-clipped argument list, each of the two star references, the T/J reference and the baseline n in n-champs. No theorem, derivation, construction or inference was independently proved or refuted; checks is therefore empty.
No date and no author page number are visible. The pencil archive foliation is 64 and is represented only by a comment. H’s page{6} is editorial pagination and is not imported as a manuscript number.

The two curved impressions beside the lower copied-sheet edge do not form an identifiable author drawing or text. Their presence is preserved in a comment and inventory entry; absence of that comment in H is not counted as an omitted drawing.

The detached terminal mark after les was reviewed as possible punctuation and retained as the s of les. An isolated point above the gap after ils does not establish baseline punctuation. These reviews are recorded rather than silently assuming that every dark spot is text.

The complete H note referring to a verification and another dossier was treated solely as editorial metadata. No other page, other reader, external transcription, OCR, browser or mathematical reference was consulted.

coverage: The whole image was viewed once for layout and dimensions, then half a and half b once each in order. All 21 main physical text lines, the interlinear parenthesis, both underlined paragraph leads, clipped heading, struck word, every inline formula, accents, punctuation, quoted words, copying-edge impressions and pencil foliation were read against the complete C and H witnesses, including agreements. Sixteen tight evidence crops were made with the supplied crop.py only for areas left unresolved by the halves; adjacent unresolved words or states sometimes share one crop. Each crop was viewed once, and no decided locus was re-cropped. There are no mathematical displays, diagrams, identifiable drawings, margin notes, typed passages, letter heading or closing, or visible author page number to add. H omits the interlinear state and struck word, leaves readable material after projectifs unreadable, changes several words and punctuation forms, and supplies a closing parenthesis not visible at the copy boundary. C doubts were all explicitly resolved or retained, with newly noticed accent uncertainties marked in place. Cross-line loci include both source boxes and identify where only one side is present in the crop. The final TeX contains the complete page, not a patch.
